findings.message: exit_code is now emitted at both the top level and inside data.exit_code with no test asserting they are equal; if a code path updates one but not the other, downstream consumers reading different paths will see divergent state silently.

SPEC-1 no longer asserts result_contract=2, so a regression that emits schema_version:1 or drops the contract marker entirely will go undetected by this suite, removing the canary for schema-version-aware consumers.

SPEC-8 concatenates two unrelated checks into a single assert_eq string ("interrupted|true"); a failure produces an opaque diff and makes it impossible to identify which sub-check failed without re-running manually.

SPEC-2 no longer validates the disposition field on any path; if disposition starts emitting a wrong value (e.g. null or an unexpected string), no SPEC assertion will catch it until SPEC-3/4/5 fire on a different code path.
